envelope.description: Add LogEditorSurface (user-read-only LightVirtualFile + FileEditorManager off-EDT stream)

body.title: Add LogEditorSurface (user-read-only LightVirtualFile + FileEditorManager off-EDT stream)
body.summary: New debug/LogEditorSurface.kt: class LogEditorSurface(seam=LogTailSeam()){ fun openLog(project, category) }. Create a user-read-only LightVirtualFile('insrc-<stem>.log', PlainTextFileType, '') (isWritable=false), open via FileEditorManager.getInstance(project).openFile(file, true), hold a bounded (MAX_BUFFER=1000) ring buffer + the current LogFilter, subscribe LogTailSeam.tail OFF the EDT, and on each batch append to the buffer then rebuild the FILTERED document text on a disposed-guarded invokeLater under a write action (never re-reads disk on a filter change). A minimal level/module/text filter toolbar re-renders from the buffer. Dispose the tail on editor close (FileEditorManagerListener.fileClosed for this file) / project close; the on-disk log is never modified (k5). Never throws (guarded). Re-opening a category re-focuses the existing tab rather than duplicating. Per the s3 critique, RESOLVE the streamed-rebuild write-action mechanism AT BUILD by a real IntelliJ-API spike BEFORE writing the loop: obtain the Document via FileDocumentManager.getInstance().getDocument(file) and rebuild it under ApplicationManager.getApplication().runWriteAction { CommandProcessor ... doc.setText(...) }, keeping the file user-read-only (isWritable=false) while allowing the plugin's own setText — verified by the source-scan test + the local build, not assumed. Keep the filter toolbar minimal (a small editor top-component or in-file header).
acceptanceChecks: openLog opens a user-read-only LightVirtualFile via FileEditorManager (k5: an editor tab, not inline) and streams the filtered bounded buffer into its Document off the EDT under a guarded invokeLater + write action (k2); the write-action rebuild mechanism is resolved against the real IntelliJ API and compiles
The on-disk log is never written/deleted/rotated/cleared; a filter change re-renders from the 1000-line buffer with no disk re-read; the buffer is bounded
The tail is disposed on editor/project close; a late post-close emit is dropped (disposed guard), never an exception; re-opening a category re-focuses the existing tab

tests.name: gradlew buildPlugin compiles the resolved FileDocumentManager/runWriteAction rebuild mechanism (JDK21)
